sentences.en: You can't eat your pudding until you finish your meat.
sentences.zh: 你不能吃布丁直到吃完肉。

sentences.en: For afters, there was rice pudding with sugar and cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 作为甜点，是加了糖和肉桂的米布丁。

sentences.en: The proof of the pudding is in the eating.

senses.zh: （一道）甜食，甜点心,布丁（通常用面粉经烘烤或蒸煮做成的美味甜食品）,肥胖而迟钝的人,航船尾碰垫
